Insightful Sheltering +5: +5 Insight bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Exceptional Seeker +5: Provides a +5 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +5 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
